# CI dependencies, every one pinned by version AND hash: pip refuses anything
# else (--require-hashes), so a package swapped on PyPI cannot run in CI.
# Resolved with a two-week cooldown (nothing newer than the cutoff) to stay
# clear of freshly published, not-yet-noticed malicious releases.
# Regenerate:
#   printf "pytest\npyyaml\nsetuptools>=77\nijson\n" > ci.in
#   uv pip compile --universal --python-version 3.9 --generate-hashes \
#       --exclude-newer <date two weeks ago> ci.in -o requirements-ci.txt
# ijson: tests read `why --json` on a 5,000-link chain, nested deeper than the stdlib json
# decoder reads before Python 3.14 (docs/known-limits.md).

    # via pytest
